reader: Builder designing autonomous business agents and wishing to measure real profit and incremental human welfare
question: Which existing evals can measure earning capability, long-horizon autonomy, observed settled net profit, and causal beneficiary wealth?
strict_distinctions: benchmark simulated dollars ≠ settled platform payout
historically priced task ≠ payment to tested model
model scoring trace ≠ independent official receipt
owner authorization to build != third-party authority to act
measured predictive fit != identified intervention effect
method: First party company technical disclosures, original peer-reviewed RCTs and code/license readback from original publisher repositories. Any company metric remains vendor-reported; owned code reviewed as read-only context, not integrated with Manager runtime.

sources.name: Andon Labs — Vending-Bench 2
sources.actually_measures: 365 simulated days, $500 opening cash, simulated final bank balance, multi-run spread and adverse behavior traces
sources.cannot_establish: No settled real revenue; no official public runnable code confirmed from linked page

sources.name: Andon Labs — Pion research preview
sources.actually_measures: Persistent agents operate email/phone/banking/browser in real partner-owned businesses with delegated permission; preview waitlist
sources.cannot_establish: Not broadly open-source/available; real stores may hire/pay humans; disclosure, employment, legal approval remain separate
sources.license_or_access: vendor terms and direct deployment evidence required

sources.name: Andon Labs — Andon Market / Café
sources.actually_measures: Actual staffed San Francisco store controlled strategically by AI
sources.cannot_establish: Not 0 human labor; Andon reports stores/cafe not profitable as of 2026-09 Pion announcement
sources.license_or_access: cite vendor story; no independent causal ledger

sources.name: Anthropic + Andon Labs — Project Vend Phase 2
sources.actually_measures: AI shopkeeper running office micro-shop with real inventory/customer transactions; progress from loss to improved economics
sources.cannot_establish: Observed real pilot and company reports; model change and scaffolding confounded; not independent generalized autonomous enterprise proof

sources.name: OpenAI — SWE-Lancer
sources.actually_measures: More than 1,400 real Upwork projects, ~$1m historic compensation weights and end-to-end task grading
sources.cannot_establish: Model does NOT get actual contracted payment; payouts are past human historical values
sources.license_or_access: https://github.com/openai/frontier-evals project/swelancer MIT repo, task licensing separate

sources.name: OpenAI — GDPval
sources.actually_measures: 44 occupations, 9 industries, expert-judged real-work style documents and deliverables
sources.cannot_establish: One-shot quality comparisons not actual customer purchases, earnings or long-horizon autonomous operation

sources.name: METR — Time Horizon 1.1
sources.actually_measures: Task length measured as human expert time at model 50%/80% success on software/research/cyber tasks
sources.cannot_establish: Not real-world duration or net-profit indicator; dated page no longer maintained

sources.name: METR — early AI developer productivity randomized trial
sources.actually_measures: Randomized issues AI allowed vs disallowed among 16 experienced OSS developers; early-2025 AI associated with 19% longer times
sources.cannot_establish: Setting/era-specific; 2026 recruitment and multi-agent measurement issues in follow-up; not income change

sources.name: TheAgentCompany — consequential workplace tasks
sources.actually_measures: Realistic digital employee tool use and coworker interactions in a simulated business
sources.cannot_establish: Simulator task success not actual jobs, wage savings or customer income

sources.name: Andon Labs — score versus deception
sources.actually_measures: Observed collusion/refund deception in simulator under profit incentives
sources.cannot_establish: Ethical behavior not proven globally by a single model run; research cautions that profit objective may reward abuse
sources.license_or_access: source methodology and runs vendor claimed

sources.name: PyMC Labs — CausalPy
sources.actually_measures: Difference-in-differences, synthetic control, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series and uncertainty
sources.cannot_establish: Estimates conditional on assumptions/data. No causal proof from installing package

sources.name: PyWhy — DoWhy
sources.actually_measures: Explicit causal graphs, identification, estimation, assumption refutation
sources.cannot_establish: Need valid design, comparators, covariate/selection overlap

sources.name: PyWhy — EconML
sources.actually_measures: CATE / heterogeneous treatment effects after identification
sources.cannot_establish: Not a license to rank vulnerable recipients without governance; observational confounding remains

sources.name: Meta — GeoLift
sources.actually_measures: Geo-level incrementality design, power checks, synthetic controls, treatment market selection
sources.cannot_establish: Needs comparable geographic data, spillover/mobility check, rights to intervene in markets

sources.name: LangChain — LangSmith eval
sources.actually_measures: Offline datasets, online production traces, deterministic + model-judge eval and monitoring
sources.cannot_establish: Agent trace or LLM judge not independent profit/beneficiary receipts
sources.license_or_access: SaaS data movement/permissions and pricing need review

sources.name: ZOZO — Open Bandit Dataset
sources.actually_measures: Historical randomized policy logs: action, propensity, click; sample and full dataset alternatives
sources.cannot_establish: Clicks are not net wealth; first 10k per arm not representative full trial; importance weights may explode
sources.license_or_access: Original code Apache2; source-user feature reuse rights separate

sources.name: Haushofer & Shapiro 2016 / GiveDirectly
sources.actually_measures: Household cash transfers randomized across village/household, monitored consumption/assets/wellbeing
sources.cannot_establish: Direct transfer is not productivity, and external donor money is not auto-created by agent

sources.name: Egger et al. 2022 Econometrica Kenya general equilibrium
sources.actually_measures: $1k+ transfers to 10.5k+ households across randomized villages; estimated ~2.5 local transfer multiplier and spillovers
sources.cannot_establish: Context-specific donor-funded intervention; does not mean AI creates 2.5x money or comparable effect elsewhere

sources.name: Hunt Allcott 2011 energy reports randomized
sources.actually_measures: ~600k household randomized trials of home energy report feedback; average electricity reduction ~2%
sources.cannot_establish: Energy use reduction not identical to financial wealth or overall welfare without cost/fuel/comfort effects
sources.license_or_access: cite original abstract, do not copy charts

sources.name: Life Manager Economic Autonomy Benchmark
sources.actually_measures: Code verifies receipt uniqueness, settled customer revenue, net after cost, recurring revenue, human intervention count, unknown effects, immutable fixtures and split
sources.cannot_establish: Life Manager separate product; do not embed proprietary operator identity or private code paths in PUBLIC article; no causal customer-welfare proof
sources.license_or_access: Actual source reviewed in connected GitHub 2026-10-21

sources.name: Life Manager Agent Contract Gate
sources.actually_measures: Heldout behavior, safety, cost/latency regression, external official readback, rollback gate
sources.cannot_establish: Not a benefit causal inference engine; do not modify Life Manager runtime or redistribute private fixtures
sources.license_or_access: Actual source reviewed in connected GitHub 2026-10-21

sources.name: Bhargava and Manoli — Psychological Frictions in EITC takeup
sources.actually_measures: 35,050 eligible tax filers unclaimed about $26m, randomized followup letters; simplified notices substantially increased claims in this setting
sources.cannot_establish: No claim AI made or distributed the cash; rights and actual taxpayer consent separate

sources.name: Linos et al. — Can Nudges Increase Take-Up of the EITC?
sources.actually_measures: Six field experiments with about one million observations; low-touch message variations did not detect higher EITC filings or claims
sources.cannot_establish: Null in these contexts does not imply all administrative assistance can never work
sources.license_or_access: Read and cite original; no redistribution of underlying taxpayers

sources.name: Goldin et al. — Tax Filing and Take-Up
sources.actually_measures: IRS letters offering free tax preparation modestly increased filing and EITC takeup
sources.cannot_establish: Does not independently validate autonomous AI filings or permission to submit another's taxes
sources.license_or_access: Cite author study, separate legal/tax representations

sources.name: Manoli, Michaelides, Patel — Nevada Reemployment and Eligibility Assessment
sources.actually_measures: Experimental job-search assistance with long-term employment, wage and benefits readback from tax administrative data
sources.cannot_establish: Human service program effect not automatically transferable to an AI job agent
sources.license_or_access: Official government review; do not use private wage records

open_questions: No confirmed publicly downloadable executable implementation of original Vending-Bench 2 or Pion; validate on official maintainer channel rather than inferring open source.
Pion waitlist access and bank/write permissions not confirmed, cannot benchmark proprietary preview.
Causal transfer of firm revenue into beneficiaries' net welfare requires separately defined P3/P4 study and counterfactual; user intervention consent where applicable.
Pricing of independent verifier time and server resources from real receipts, not invented defaults.
publication_limits: Never use personal owner handle/path or live bank balances in public editorial; use source-backed public references; published model outputs are not independently peer reviewed.
integration_boundary: Manager != Life Manager. Reuse only scientific methods and approved high-level schema via separately authorized, read-only aggregate interface; do not import source/runtime/keys.
